window.RouteLabels=(()=>{
 const overlap=(a,b,g=4)=>a.x<b.x+b.w+g&&a.x+a.w+g>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h+g&&a.y+a.h+g>b.y;
 function hit(r,a,b,p=6){
  const x0=r.x-p,x1=r.x+r.w+p,y0=r.y-p,y1=r.y+r.h+p;
  if(Math.max(a[0],b[0])<x0||Math.min(a[0],b[0])>x1||Math.max(a[1],b[1])<y0||Math.min(a[1],b[1])>y1)return false;
  let lo=0,hi=1;const dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];
  for(const [v,q] of [[-dx,a[0]-x0],[dx,x1-a[0]],[-dy,a[1]-y0],[dy,y1-a[1]]]){
   if(Math.abs(v)<1e-9){if(q<0)return false;}else{const t=q/v;if(v<0)lo=Math.max(lo,t);else hi=Math.min(hi,t);if(lo>hi)return false;}
  }return true;
 }
 function place(ax,ay,w,h,W,H,occupied,segments,pref=[]){
  if(w>W-12||h>H-12)return null;
  const choices=[...pref,[14,-h/2],[-w-14,-h/2],[-w/2,-h-18],[-w/2,18],[18,-h-12],[-w-18,-h-12],[18,12],[-w-18,12]];
  for(const r of [55,85,120,165,215])for(const a of [0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315])choices.push([Math.cos(a*Math.PI/180)*r-w/2,Math.sin(a*Math.PI/180)*r-h/2]);
  const valid=r=>!occupied.some(o=>overlap(r,o))&&!segments.some(([a,b])=>hit(r,a,b));
  let best=null,score=Infinity;
  function test(x,y){const r={x:Math.max(6,Math.min(W-w-6,x)),y:Math.max(6,Math.min(H-h-6,y)),w,h};if(!valid(r))return;const s=Math.hypot(r.x+w/2-ax,r.y+h/2-ay);if(s<score){score=s;best=r;}}
  choices.forEach(([x,y])=>test(ax+x,ay+y));
  if(!best)for(let y=6;y<=H-h-6;y+=16)for(let x=6;x<=W-w-6;x+=16)test(x,y);
  return best;
 }

 return {place,hit,overlap,edge};

  buildOverlay(){
    this.overlay.innerHTML=this.stations.map(([name])=>`<span class="station-label"><i></i>${E.esc(name)}</span>`).join('')+
      (this.region.marks||[]).map(([name])=>`<span class="landmark-label">◇ ${E.esc(name)}</span>`).join('')+

    this.pinEls=new Map([...this.overlay.querySelectorAll('[data-map-hotel]')].map(el=>[el.dataset.mapHotel,el]));

  fitPoints(pts,padding){
    const valid=pts.filter(p=>p&&p.every(Number.isFinite));
    if(!valid.length)return {cx:0,cy:0,w:1000};
    const x0=Math.min(...valid.map(p=>p[0])),x1=Math.max(...valid.map(p=>p[0]));
    const y0=Math.min(...valid.map(p=>p[1])),y1=Math.max(...valid.map(p=>p[1]));
    const {l,r,t,b}=padding, aw=Math.max(80,this.width-l-r),ah=Math.max(90,this.height-t-b);
    const s=Math.max((x1-x0)/aw,(y1-y0)/ah,360/this.width);
    return {cx:(x0+x1)/2+(r-l)*s/2,cy:(y0+y1)/2+(b-t)*s/2,w:s*this.width};
  }
  overviewCamera(){
    const pts=[];
    this.region.hotels.forEach(h=>{pts.push(P(h.lat,h.lon),P(...h.stationLL));});
    for(const [,la,lo] of [...(this.region.marks||[]),...(this.region.extraSt||[])])pts.push(P(la,lo));
    return this.fitPoints(pts,{l:55,r:55,t:91,b:54});
  }
  hotelCamera(id){
    const h=this.region.hotels.find(h=>h.id===id);if(!h)return this.overviewCamera();
    // Only this hotel's source route and nearest station determine the close-up.
    // Do NOT include other hotels or a distant main railway station here.
    const pts=(M.routes[id]||[]).map(([lo,la])=>P(la,lo));
    pts.push(P(h.lat,h.lon),P(...h.stationLL));
    return this.fitPoints(pts,{l:48,r:48,t:this.height<270?69:93,b:this.height<270?34:57});
  }
  clampCamera(c){
    const ov=this.overviewCamera(),w=Math.min(ov.w,Math.max(120,c.w||1000)),k=this.height/this.width;
    let cx=Number.isFinite(c.cx)?c.cx:ov.cx,cy=Number.isFinite(c.cy)?c.cy:ov.cy;
    const mx=(ov.w-w)/2,my=(ov.w-w)*k/2;cx=Math.max(ov.cx-mx,Math.min(ov.cx+mx,cx));cy=Math.max(ov.cy-my,Math.min(ov.cy+my,cy));
    return {cx,cy,w};
  }

  stopFlight(){cancelAnimationFrame(this.flight);this.flight=0;this.el.dataset.animating='false';}
  fly(to,animate=true){
    this.stopFlight();to=this.clampCamera(to);
    if(!this.cam||!animate||matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){this.cam=to;this.apply();return;}
    const from={...this.cam},started=performance.now(),distance=Math.hypot(to.cx-from.cx,to.cy-from.cy);
    const duration=distance>2500?650:540,span=Math.max(from.w,to.w);
    // A restrained pull-back connects far-apart neighbourhoods without teleporting.
    const arc=Math.max(0,distance*.8-span);
    const step=now=>{
      if(this.destroyed)return;
      const t=Math.min(1,(now-started)/duration),e=t<.5?4*t*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,3)/2;
      this.cam={cx:from.cx+(to.cx-from.cx)*e,cy:from.cy+(to.cy-from.cy)*e,w:from.w+(to.w-from.w)*e+Math.sin(Math.PI*t)**2*arc};
      this.apply();
      if(t<1)this.flight=requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else{this.cam=to;this.flight=0;this.el.dataset.animating='false';this.apply();}
    };
    this.el.dataset.animating='true';this.flight=requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  fit(animate=true){

  manualZoom(f,anchor=null){

  bind(){
    const listen=(el,ev,fn,opts)=>{el.addEventListener(ev,fn,opts);this.handlers.push(()=>el.removeEventListener(ev,fn,opts));};
    listen(this.el,'click',e=>{
      const h=e.target.closest('[data-map-hotel]');
      if(h){e.stopPropagation();this.onFocus(h.dataset.mapHotel);return;}
      const z=e.target.closest('[data-zoom]');
      if(z){if(z.dataset.zoom==='fit')this.fit(true);else this.manualZoom(z.dataset.zoom==='in'?.68:1/.68);}
    });
    listen(this.el,'pointerdown',e=>{
      if(e.target.closest('button'))return;if(this.atOverview())return;this.stopFlight();
      this.pointers.set(e.pointerId,[e.clientX,e.clientY]);this.el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    });
    listen(this.el,'pointermove',e=>{
      if(!this.pointers.has(e.pointerId)||!this.cam)return;
      const before=[...this.pointers.values()],prev=this.pointers.get(e.pointerId);
      this.pointers.set(e.pointerId,[e.clientX,e.clientY]);
      if(this.pointers.size===1){const s=this.cam.w/this.width;this.cam=this.clampCamera({...this.cam,cx:this.cam.cx-(e.clientX-prev[0])*s,cy:this.cam.cy-(e.clientY-prev[1])*s});}
      else if(this.pointers.size===2){
        const after=[...this.pointers.values()],length=p=>Math.hypot(p[0][0]-p[1][0],p[0][1]-p[1][1]);
        const oldD=length(before),newD=length(after);if(newD>2)this.cam=this.clampCamera({...this.cam,w:this.cam.w*oldD/newD});
      }
      this.cameraMode='manual';this.updateChrome();this.apply();
    });
    const up=e=>this.pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
    listen(this.el,'pointerup',up);listen(this.el,'pointercancel',up);listen(this.el,'lostpointercapture',up);

function regions(){return `<div class="regions">${D.regions.map((r,i)=>`<button data-region="${r.id}" class="${r.id===region?'active':''}" aria-pressed="${r.id===region}"><div><b>${r.name}</b><small>${r.dates} · ${r.nights} 晚</small><small class="rg-n">${r.nights} 晚・${r.hotels.length>1?r.hotels.length+' 選 1':'已訂'}</small></div><i>${E.selected(r.id)?'✓':String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</i></button>`).join('')}</div>`}

function scrollCardTo(id,smooth=true){const box=document.getElementById('m-cards'),c=box?.querySelector(`[data-card="${id}"]`);if(!box||!c||box.scrollWidth<=box.clientWidth+2)return;box.dataset.lock='1';box.scrollTo({left:c.offsetLeft-box.offsetLeft-(box.clientWidth-c.offsetWidth)/2,behavior:smooth?'smooth':'instant'});clearTimeout(box._u);box._u=setTimeout(()=>{box.dataset.lock=''},600)}
function syncDots(){document.querySelectorAll('#m-dots i').forEach(d=>d.classList.toggle('on',d.dataset.dot===focus))}
function bindCards(){const box=document.getElementById('m-cards');if(!box)return;requestAnimationFrame(()=>scrollCardTo(focus,false));let t;box.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(box.dataset.lock)return;clearTimeout(t);t=setTimeout(()=>{const mid=box.scrollLeft+box.clientWidth/2+box.offsetLeft;let best=null,bd=1e9;box.querySelectorAll('[data-card]').forEach(c=>{const d=Math.abs(c.offsetLeft+c.offsetWidth/2-mid);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=c.dataset.card}});if(best&&best!==focus)focusHotel(best,{fromCards:true})},140)},{passive:true})}

function journeyPath(i){const m=JP.matsuyama,t=JP.takamatsu,k=JP.kotohira,a=JP.airport,sm=hotelPoint('mat',m),sd=hotelPoint('dogo',JP.dogo);if(i===3)return `M${t} Q957 256 ${k}`;if(i===4)return `M${k} Q915 431 ${JP.oboke} Q768 431 ${k} Q599 490 ${m} L${sm}`;if(i===5)return `M${sm} L${m} Q168 596 ${JP.shimonada} Q236 651 ${m} L${sd}`;if(i===7)return `M${sd} L${m} Q650 430 ${t} L${a}`;return pathOf(routePoints(i));}
function stayPointForDay(i){const rid=i<3?'tak':i===3?'koto':i===4?'mat':i<=6?'dogo':i===7?'dogo':null;if(!rid)return null;const base=rid==='tak'?JP.takamatsu:rid==='koto'?JP.kotohira:rid==='mat'?JP.matsuyama:JP.dogo;const h=E.hotel(E.selected(rid));return{rid,coord:hotelPoint(rid,base),name:h?h.short:E.region(rid).name+'住宿',sub:i===7?'出發前住宿':i===6?'今晚續住':'今晚住宿'};}
function dayContextItems(i){const stay=stayPointForDay(i),items=[];if(stay)items.push({kind:'stay',coord:stay.coord,title:stay.name,sub:stay.sub});
 const push=(kind,coord,title,sub='')=>items.push({kind,coord,title,sub});
 switch(i){
  case 0: push('station',[1004,195],'高松築港','機場巴士銜接'); break;
  case 1: push('station',[1006,192],'高松港','往返渡輪'); push('landmark',[1018,162],'女木島','鬼之洞窟／海岸'); push('landmark',[1023,136],'男木島','聚落與燈塔'); break;
  case 2: push('station',[1002,190],'JR 高松站','借車起點'); push('landmark',[1048,201],'玉藻公園','高松城跡'); push('landmark',[1035,225],'栗林公園','庭園散策'); break;
  case 3: push('station',[878,297],'琴平站','下午入住'); push('landmark',[858,286],'金刀比羅宮','夜祭動線'); break;
  case 4: push('station',[879,302],'JR 琴平站','接駁起訖'); push('landmark',[844,519],'祖谷・大步危','上午主行程'); push('station',[265,548],'JR 松山站','下午回城'); break;
  case 5: push('station',[264,548],'JR 松山站','寄存／取件'); push('landmark',[168,677],'下灘站','海景主行程'); push('station',[282,540],'道後溫泉站','下午轉住'); break;
  case 6: push('station',[282,540],'道後溫泉站','溫泉街散策'); push('landmark',[293,531],'道後本館','周邊散步'); break;
  case 7: push('station',[264,548],'JR 松山站','回程起點'); push('station',[1012,190],'JR 高松站','轉機場巴士'); push('station',[997,285],'高松機場','CI179'); break;
 }
 return items;
}

  case 3:return[{coord:JP.takamatsu,time:'午後',title:'高松出發',sub:'琴電前往琴平',kind:'hub',side:'left'},{coord:[878,297],time:'下午',title:'琴平站',sub:'抵達後寄物／入住',kind:'hub',side:'right'},{coord:[858,286],time:'夜間',title:'金刀比羅宮',sub:'夜祭主場',kind:'stop',side:'left'},{coord:stayKoto,time:'今晚',title:'今晚住宿',sub:'琴平區 1 晚',kind:'stay',side:'right'}];

class JourneyMap{
 constructor(el,contextDay=null){
  this.el=el;this.day=contextDay===null?homeDay:contextDay;this.isDaily=contextDay!==null;this.frame=0;this.destroyed=false;this.w=el.clientWidth||360;this.h=el.clientHeight||350;
  el.innerHTML=`<svg class="journey-svg" aria-label="四國行程地理總覽"><rect x="-2000" y="-2000" width="6000" height="6000" fill="#0e2330"/>${HD.coast}<g class="journey-routes"></g><g class="journey-dots"></g></svg><svg class="journey-leaders" aria-hidden="true"></svg><div class="journey-overlay"></div><div class="journey-milestones"></div><div class="journey-pins"></div><div class="journey-controls"><button data-journey-zoom="in" aria-label="放大地圖">＋</button><button data-journey-zoom="out" aria-label="縮小地圖">−</button><button data-journey-zoom="fit">${this.isDaily?'本日':'全景'}</button></div><div class="journey-map-legend"><span class="leg-land">主行程</span><span class="leg-sea">海路／返程</span><span class="leg-zone">活動範圍</span></div><div class="journey-credit">© OpenStreetMap contributors<br>區域與連線為示意，非道路導航</div>`;
  this.svg=el.querySelector('.journey-svg');this.overlay=el.querySelector('.journey-overlay');this.milestoneLayer=el.querySelector('.journey-milestones');this.pins=el.querySelector('.journey-pins');this.routes=el.querySelector('.journey-routes');this.dots=el.querySelector('.journey-dots');
  this.box=!this.isDaily&&homeCamera?[...homeCamera]:this.target();
  this.draw();this.to(this.target(),!this.isDaily&&!!homeCamera);
  this.syncInitial();
  this.ro=new ResizeObserver(()=>{const w=el.clientWidth||360,h=el.clientHeight||350;if(Math.abs(w-this.w)>1||Math.abs(h-this.h)>1){this.w=w;this.h=h;this.to(this.target(),false)}});this.ro.observe(el);
  this.click=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-journey-zoom]');if(!b)return;e.stopPropagation();if(b.dataset.journeyZoom==='fit'){if(!this.isDaily){homeDay=-1;homePhoto=0;photoFocus=false;view='home';render();scrollHome();return;}this.to(this.target(),true);return;}const f=b.dataset.journeyZoom==='in'?.75:1.35,c=this.box;if(c[2]*f<22||c[2]*f>6000)return;this.to([c[0]+c[2]*(1-f)/2,c[1]+c[3]*(1-f)/2,c[2]*f,c[3]*f],true)};el.addEventListener('click',this.click);
 }
 syncInitial(){requestAnimationFrame(()=>this.reflow(true));setTimeout(()=>this.reflow(true),120);setTimeout(()=>this.reflow(false),360)}
 reflow(fit=false){if(this.destroyed)return;const w=this.el.clientWidth||360,h=this.el.clientHeight||350;if(Math.abs(w-this.w)>1||Math.abs(h-this.h)>1){this.w=w;this.h=h}if(fit){this.box=this.target();this.apply();}}
 fit(b){const a=this.w/this.h;let w=b[2],h=b[3];if(a>w/h)w=h*a;else h=w/a;return[b[0]+b[2]/2-w/2,b[1]+b[3]/2-h/2,w,h];}
 dayBounds(i){let pts=(routePoints(i)||[]).map(p=>Array.isArray(p)?p:[0,0]);const stay=stayPointForDay(i);if(stay)pts=pts.concat([stay.coord]);if(i===2)pts=pts.concat([[977,173],[1068,255]]);if(i===6)pts=pts.concat([[269,525],[304,560]]);const xs=pts.map(p=>p[0]),ys=pts.map(p=>p[1]);const minX=Math.min(...xs),maxX=Math.max(...xs),minY=Math.min(...ys),maxY=Math.max(...ys);const padX=i===4?100:76,padY=i===4?88:74;return[minX-padX,minY-padY,maxX-minX+padX*2,maxY-minY+padY*2];}
 target(){if(this.day<0)return this.fit([105,60,1080,665]);
  if(!this.isDaily&&photoFocus){const t=HD.photos[homeDay][homePhoto]?.target;const boxes={chichibu:[730,140,405,255],ogi:[915,82,230,160],matsuyama:[175,467,188,160],dogo:[230,498,103,102],takamatsu:[958,140,140,150],kotohira:[801,220,180,160]};if(boxes[t])return this.fit(boxes[t]);}
  return this.fit(this.dayBounds(this.day));
 }
 draw(){let paths='';const active=this.day<0?[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]:[this.day];
  for(const i of active){if(routePoints(i).length>1){const d=journeyPath(i),tone=i===1?'sea':i===7?'return':'';paths+=`<path class="journey-route ${tone}" data-route-day="${i}" d="${d}" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/><path class="route-flow ${i===7?'return':''}" d="${d}" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>`;}}
  if(active.includes(2))paths+='<path class="journey-area" d="M988 173Q977 173 977 188L977 241Q977 255 992 255L1053 255Q1068 255 1068 240L1068 188Q1068 173 1053 173Z" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>';
  if(active.includes(6))paths+='<path class="journey-area" d="M277 525Q269 525 269 533L269 552Q269 560 279 560L296 560Q304 560 304 550L304 533Q304 525 296 525Z" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>';
  if(this.day===2&&!this.isDaily&&HD.photos[2][homePhoto]?.optional){const od=pathOf([JP.takamatsu,JP.chichibu]);paths+=`<path class="journey-route optional" d="${od}" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/><path class="route-flow" d="${od}" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>`};
  this.routes.innerHTML=paths;
  const names=[['takamatsu',this.day===2?'高松市區騎行':'高松','10/07–10 · 3 晚',0,'takJR'],['kotohira','琴平','10/10 · 1 晚',3,'kotoJR'],['matsuyama','松山','10/11 · 城下町散策',4,'matsuJR'],['dogo','道後','10/12–14 · 2 晚',5,'dogoSt'],['airport','高松機場','去回程交通',7,'airport'],['megi','女木島','10/08 · 海岸散策',1,'megi'],['ogi','男木島','10/08 · 聚落散策',1,'ogi'],['shimonada','下灘','10/12 · 上午主行程',5,'shimonada'],['oboke','祖谷・大步危','10/11 · 上午主行程',4,'oboke']];
  const keys=this.day<0?names.map(n=>n[0]):[['takamatsu','airport'],['takamatsu','megi','ogi'],['takamatsu'],['takamatsu','kotohira'],['kotohira','oboke','matsuyama'],['matsuyama','shimonada','dogo'],['dogo'],['dogo','matsuyama','takamatsu','airport']][this.day];
  this.nodes=names.filter(n=>keys.includes(n[0]));if(this.day===2&&!this.isDaily&&HD.photos[2][homePhoto]?.optional)this.nodes.push(['chichibu','父母ヶ浜','替代方案',2,'chichibu']);
  this.pins.innerHTML=this.isDaily?'':this.nodes.map(([k,n,sub,i,p])=>`<button class="journey-pin ${this.day===i||this.day===2&&k==='takamatsu'||this.day===6&&k==='dogo'?'active':''}" ${this.isDaily?`data-map-place="${p}"`:`data-home-day="${i}"`} data-place="${k}" aria-label="${E.esc(n)}"><b>${E.esc(n)}</b><small>${E.esc(sub)}</small></button>`).join('');
  this.dots.innerHTML=this.nodes.map(([k,n])=>`<circle class="journey-dot" data-dot="${k}" cx="${JP[k][0]}" cy="${JP[k][1]}" r="6" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"><title>${E.esc(n)}</title></circle>`).join('');
  this.contextItems=(this.day<0||this.isDaily?[]:dayContextItems(this.day)).slice(0,4);
  this.overlay.innerHTML=this.contextItems.map((it,idx)=>`<div class="map-context ${it.kind}" data-context="${idx}"><span class="map-context-kicker">${it.kind==='stay'?'今夜住宿':it.kind==='station'?'交通節點':'重點地標'}</span><b>${E.esc(it.title)}</b>${it.sub?`<small>${E.esc(it.sub)}</small>`:''}</div>`).join('');
  this.milestones=(this.day<0?[]:dayMilestones(this.day)).slice(0,this.isDaily?4:5);
  this.milestoneLayer.innerHTML=this.milestones.map((it,idx)=>`<div class="map-milestone ${it.kind||'stop'}" data-milestone="${idx}"><span class="map-milestone-time">${E.esc(it.time)}</span><b>${E.esc(it.title)}</b>${it.sub?`<small>${E.esc(it.sub)}</small>`:''}</div>`).join('');
  this.worldRoutes=[...this.routes.querySelectorAll('path')].map(p=>{const len=p.getTotalLength(),count=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(len/10));return Array.from({length:count+1},(_,i)=>{const v=p.getPointAtLength(len*i/count);return[v.x,v.y]});});
  this.apply();
 }
 apply(){if(this.destroyed)return;this.svg.setAttribute('viewBox',this.box.join(' '));if(!this.isDaily)homeCamera=[...this.box];const scale=this.w/this.box[2],px=p=>[(p[0]-this.box[0])*scale,(p[1]-this.box[1])*scale],segments=[];
  this.worldRoutes.forEach(ps=>{for(let i=1;i<ps.length;i++)segments.push([px(ps[i-1]),px(ps[i])]);});
  const occ=[{x:this.w-127,y:5,w:122,h:46},{x:0,y:this.h-32,w:this.w,h:32}],lines=[];
  const nodes=(this.isDaily?[]:this.nodes.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b[3]===this.day)-(a[3]===this.day)));
  for(const n of nodes){const[k]=n,[x,y]=px(JP[k]),b=this.pins.querySelector(`[data-place="${k}"]`);const show=x>=0&&x<=this.w&&y>=0&&y<=this.h;b.style.display=show?'block':'none';this.dots.querySelector(`[data-dot="${k}"]`)?.setAttribute('r',String(4.5/scale));if(!show)continue;
   const r=RouteLabels.place(x,y,b.offsetWidth,b.offsetHeight,this.w,this.h,occ,segments);if(!r){b.style.display='none';continue;}occ.push(r);b.style.left=r.x+'px';b.style.top=r.y+'px';const [ex,ey]=RouteLabels.edge(r,x,y);lines.push(`<path d="M${x},${y}L${ex},${ey}"/>`);
  }
  this.contextItems.forEach((it,idx)=>{const el=this.overlay.querySelector(`[data-context="${idx}"]`);if(!el)return;const [x,y]=px(it.coord),show=x>=-20&&x<=this.w+20&&y>=-20&&y<=this.h+20;el.style.display=show?'grid':'none';if(!show)return;const pref=it.kind==='stay'?[[14,-6],[-el.offsetWidth-14,-6],[-el.offsetWidth/2,18]]:[[10,10],[12,-el.offsetHeight-12],[-el.offsetWidth-14,8]];const r=RouteLabels.place(x,y,el.offsetWidth,el.offsetHeight,this.w,this.h,occ,segments,pref);if(!r){el.style.display='none';return;}occ.push(r);el.style.left=(r.x+r.w/2)+'px';el.style.top=(r.y+r.h/2)+'px';if(it.kind==='stay'){const [ex,ey]=RouteLabels.edge(r,x,y);lines.push(`<path class="stay-leader" d="M${x},${y}L${ex},${ey}"/>`);}});
  this.milestones.forEach((it,idx)=>{const el=this.milestoneLayer.querySelector(`[data-milestone="${idx}"]`);if(!el)return;const [x,y]=px(it.coord),show=x>=-24&&x<=this.w+24&&y>=-24&&y<=this.h+24;el.style.display=show?'grid':'none';if(!show)return;const w=el.offsetWidth,h=el.offsetHeight;
    const pref=it.side==='left'?[[-w-16,-h/2],[-w-16,-h-12],[-w-16,10],[14,-h/2]]:it.side==='right'?[[14,-h/2],[14,-h-12],[14,10],[-w-16,-h/2]]:it.side==='above'?[[-w/2,-h-16],[14,-h/2],[-w-16,-h/2],[-w/2,12]]:it.side==='below'?[[-w/2,12],[14,10],[-w-16,10],[-w/2,-h-16]]:[[14,-h/2],[-w-16,-h/2],[-w/2,-h-16],[-w/2,12]];
    const r=RouteLabels.place(x,y,w,h,this.w,this.h,occ,segments,pref);if(!r){el.style.display='none';return;}occ.push(r);el.style.left=(r.x+r.w/2)+'px';el.style.top=(r.y+r.h/2)+'px';const [ex,ey]=RouteLabels.edge(r,x,y);lines.push(`<path class="milestone-leader ${it.kind||'stop'}" d="M${x},${y}L${ex},${ey}"/>`);
  });
  const s=this.el.querySelector('.journey-leaders');s.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${this.w} ${this.h}`);s.innerHTML=lines.join('');this.el.dataset.visibleLabels=String(occ.length-2);
 }
 to(b,animate){cancelAnimationFrame(this.frame);const from=[...this.box],start=performance.now(),ms=animate&&!matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches?300:0;const tick=now=>{if(this.destroyed)return;const p=ms?Math.min(1,(now-start)/ms):1,k=1-(1-p)**3;this.box=b.map((x,i)=>from[i]+(x-from[i])*k);this.apply();if(p<1)this.frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick);};this.frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick);}
 destroy(){this.destroyed=true;cancelAnimationFrame(this.frame);this.ro?.disconnect();this.el.removeEventListener('click',this.click);}
}



function focusCard(){const h=E.hotel(focus);return `<div class="focus-card"><div class="focus-photo"><img src="${h.image}" alt="${E.esc(h.photoType)}"><span class="photo-label">${E.esc(h.photoType)}</span></div><div class="focus-info"><div class="info-head"><span class="id-badge">${h.no}</span><h3>${E.esc(h.short)}</h3></div><p>${E.esc(h.room)}</p><div class="focus-stats"><div><small>每人每晚・參考換算</small><b class="num">${E.fmt(E.price(h).perNight)} <small>NT$</small></b></div><div><small>${E.esc(h.station)}</small><b class="num">${h.walk} <small>分／步行</small></b></div></div><div class="focus-actions"><button class="btn" data-detail="${h.id}">方案詳情</button><a class="btn" href="${E.walkURL(h)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">步行導航 ↗</a></div>${h.shortNotice?`<div class="focus-note">${E.esc(h.shortNotice)}<br>${h.id==='yaya'?'即時房況以訂房頁為準。':'條件依原檔，請向住宿確認。'}</div>`:''}</div></div>`}
function updateColumnFocus(){
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-column-focus]').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('focused',c.dataset.columnFocus===focus));
 document.querySelectorAll('.hotel-column-head').forEach(b=>{const on=b.dataset.focus===focus;b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on));b.querySelector('.focus-indicator').textContent=on?'⌖ 查看中':'⌖ 看位置'});
}
function focusHotel(id,opt={}){
 if(view!=='stay'||!E.region(region).hotels.some(h=>h.id===id))return;
 focus=id;document.getElementById('focus-card').innerHTML=focusCard();updateColumnFocus();
 // A column always means a geographic close-up, even when a plot was open.
 const wasPlot=mapView!=='map';mapView='map';
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-mapview]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.mapview==='map'));
 if(false){
  showMap=true;document.querySelector('.workspace').classList.add('show-map');
  const toggle=document.getElementById('show-map');toggle.querySelector('b').textContent='收起 −';toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
  mountMap();
 }else if(wasPlot)mountMap();

  if(atlas?.mode==='map')mapStates[atlas.region.id]=atlas.snapshot();

function point(id){if(!id)return null;if(id.startsWith('stay:')){const r=E.region(id.slice(5)),h=E.hotel(E.selected(r.id));return h?{id,name:h.name,q:h.lat+','+h.lon,detail:h.gq,h,region:r.id}:{id,name:r.name+'住宿待選',q:null,region:r.id}}return ROUTE_PLACES[id]?{id,...ROUTE_PLACES[id]}:null}

function directions(from,to,mode='walk',current=false){const a=point(from),b=point(to);if(!b?.q||(!current&&!a?.q)||['ferry','shuttle'].includes(mode))return '';const params=new URLSearchParams({api:'1',destination:b.q,travelmode:(MODE[mode]||MODE.walk).code});if(!current)params.set('origin',a.q);else params.set('dir_action','navigate');return 'https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?'+params.toString()}
function routeEmbedURL(from,to,mode='walk'){const a=point(from),b=point(to);if(!a?.q||!b?.q)return '';const params=new URLSearchParams({saddr:a.q,daddr:b.q,hl:'zh-TW',z:'14',output:'embed'});return 'https://maps.google.com/maps?'+params.toString()}

function milestoneName(m){const p=point(m[0]);return m[1]||(p?.h?p.h.short:p?.name||'住宿待選');}
class ProposalFlow{
 constructor(el,i){this.el=el;this.i=i;this.ro=new ResizeObserver(()=>this.draw());this.ro.observe(el);this.draw();}
 draw(){
  if(!this.el.isConnected)return;const W=this.el.clientWidth||360,items=PROPOSAL_MILESTONES[this.i],N=items.length,vertical=W<650;
  const H=vertical?N*76+66:286,zone=[2,6].includes(this.i);this.el.style.height=H+'px';
  const positions=items.map((_,k)=>vertical?[W/2,56+k*76]:[44+(W-88)*k/(N-1),146+(k%2?12:-12)]);
  const bw=vertical?Math.max(90,Math.min(158,W/2-37)):Math.min(154,(W-48)/N-9);
  let paths='',dots='',labels='',leaders='';
  positions.forEach(([x,y],k)=>{
   if(k){const [px,py]=positions[k-1],mode=items[k][4],dash=mode==='ship'||mode==='plane'?'stroke-dasharray="6 6"':'';paths+=`<path class="flow-route ${mode}" d="M${px},${py}L${x},${y}" ${dash}/><path class="route-flow ${mode==='plane'?'return':''}" d="M${px},${py}L${x},${y}"/>`;
    const mx=(px+x)/2,my=(py+y)/2,ang=Math.atan2(y-py,x-px)*180/Math.PI;paths+=`<path class="flow-direction" d="M-3 -3L1 0L-3 3" transform="translate(${mx} ${my}) rotate(${ang})"/>`;}
   const m=items[k],p=point(m[0]),left=vertical?k%2===0:undefined;
   const labelX=vertical?(left?x-24-bw:x+24):Math.min(W-bw-8,Math.max(8,x-bw/2)),labelY=vertical?y-31:(k%2?y+31:y-100);
   const lx=vertical?(left?labelX+bw:labelX):Math.max(labelX,Math.min(labelX+bw,x)),ly=vertical?y:(k%2?labelY:labelY+70);
   leaders+=`<path class="flow-leader" d="M${x},${y}L${lx},${ly}"/>`;
   const a=p?.q?`data-map-place="${E.esc(m[0])}"`:p?.region?`data-edit-stay="${p.region}"`:'';
   labels+=`<button class="flow-label ${vertical?(left?'left':'right'):'horizontal'}" style="left:${labelX}px;top:${labelY}px;width:${bw}px" ${a} aria-label="${E.esc(m[2]+' '+milestoneName(m))}"><span class="flow-time num">${E.esc(m[2])}</span><b>${E.esc(milestoneName(m))}</b><small>${E.esc(m[3])}</small></button>`;
   dots+=`<circle class="flow-dot" cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="10"/><text class="flow-number" x="${x}" y="${y+3.5}" text-anchor="middle">${k+1}</text>`;
  });
  const zoneSvg=zone?`<rect class="flow-zone" x="8" y="13" width="${W-16}" height="${H-26}" rx="25"/>`:'';
  this.el.innerHTML=`<svg class="flow-svg" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" aria-label="${E.esc(PLAN_DAYS[this.i].title)}交通順序示意">${zoneSvg}${paths}${leaders}${dots}</svg><div class="flow-label-layer">${labels}</div>`;
 }
 destroy(){this.ro?.disconnect();}
}

function expenseSummary(){const f=flightTotals(),extras=(E.state.expenses||[]).reduce((s,x)=>s+extraValue(x),0);return {...f,extras,known:f.total+extras}}
const EXP_CATS={transport:'當地交通',meal:'餐飲',ticket:'門票・體驗',other:'其他支出'};
function costStayRow(r){const h=E.hotel(E.selected(r.id));return `<article class="expense-stay-row ${h?'':'unselected'}"><div class="stay-location"><span>${r.name}</span><small>${r.dates} · ${r.nights} 晚</small></div><div class="stay-selection"><label class="sr-only" for="cost-stay-${r.id}">${r.name}住宿方案</label><select id="cost-stay-${r.id}" data-cost-stay="${r.id}" aria-label="${r.name}住宿方案">${r.hotels.length>1?`<option value="" ${!h?'selected':''}>選擇住宿方案</option>`:''}${r.hotels.map(v=>`<option value="${v.id}" ${h?.id===v.id?'selected':''}>${E.esc(v.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select><small>${h?`${h.breakfast.includes('未含')?icon('x'):icon('check')} 早餐 · ${h.dinner.includes('未含')?icon('x'):icon('check')} 晚餐${h.unbooked?' · 尚未預訂':''}`:'未列入住宿小計'}</small></div><div class="stay-money">${h?`<b class="num">${E.fmt(E.price(h).perPerson)}</b><small>每人・${r.nights} 晚</small>`:'<b class="missing-price">待選</b><small>待確認後列入</small>'}</div>${h?`<button class="expense-detail" data-detail="${h.id}" aria-label="${E.esc(h.name)}方案詳情">${icon('chev')}</button>`:''}</article>`}
function extraRows(){const xs=E.state.expenses||[];return xs.length?xs.map((x,i)=>`<div class="extra-row"><div><b>${E.esc(x.name)}</b><small>${D.days[x.day].date} · ${EXP_CATS[x.category]}${x.currency==='JPY'?' · 每人 ¥'+E.fmt(x.amount):''}</small></div><b class="num">NT$${E.fmt(extraValue(x))}</b><button class="delete-expense" data-delete-expense="${i}" aria-label="刪除 ${E.esc(x.name)}">×</button></div>`).join(''):'<div class="extra-empty"><div>'+icon('wallet')+'</div><h3>當地支出尚未登錄</h3><p>交通、餐飲、門票與現場稅費，依實際登錄金額列入。</p></div>'}
function dailyCosts(){const f=expenseSummary(),rows=D.days.map((x,i)=>({day:i,date:x.date,stay:0,flight:i===0?D.flightTwd:0,extras:0,missing:i<7&&!E.selected(i<3?'tak':i===3?'koto':i===4?'mat':'dogo')}));let pos=0;for(const r of D.regions){const h=E.hotel(E.selected(r.id)),amount=h?(h.currency==='TWD'?E.price(h).perPerson:Math.round(E.price(h).perPerson)):0,base=Math.floor(amount/r.nights),rem=amount-base*r.nights;for(let j=0;j<r.nights;j++)rows[pos+j].stay=base+(j<rem?1:0);pos+=r.nights}(E.state.expenses||[]).forEach(x=>rows[x.day].extras+=extraValue(x));rows.forEach(x=>x.total=x.stay+x.flight+x.extras);return rows}
function dailyCostView(){const rows=dailyCosts(),max=Math.max(...rows.map(x=>x.total),1);return `<section class="expense-ledger"><div class="ledger-heading"><div><h2>每日費用分配</h2><p>每人・台幣 NT$；來回機票於出發日一次列入。</p></div></div><div class="daily-cost-chart" aria-label="每日費用分配">${rows.map(x=>`<button class="day-cost-bar" data-open-day="${x.day}"><span class="bar-amount num">${E.fmt(x.total)}</span><span class="bar-well"><i style="height:${Math.max(2,x.total/max*100)}%"></i></span><b class="num">${x.date}</b><small>${x.missing?'住宿待選':x.day===7?'返台':'已列住宿'}</small></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="allocation-table"><div class="allocation-head"><span>日期</span><span>機票</span><span>住宿</span><span>其他</span><span>小計</span></div>${rows.map(x=>`<div class="allocation-row"><button data-open-day="${x.day}">${x.date}</button><span class="num">${x.flight?E.fmt(x.flight):'—'}</span><span class="num ${x.missing?'is-pending':''}">${x.missing?'待選':x.stay?E.fmt(x.stay):'—'}</span><span class="num">${x.extras?E.fmt(x.extras):'未登錄'}</span><b class="num">${E.fmt(x.total)}</b></div>`).join('')}</div><p class="micro">住宿按入住夜分配，尾差分攤至前幾晚，以維持每日加總與總額一致。此表是費用歸屬，不是實際付款日。</p></section>`}

function render(){proposalMap?.destroy();proposalMap=null;proposalGeo?.destroy();proposalGeo=null;homeAtlas?.destroy();homeAtlas=null;if(atlas?.mode==='map')mapStates[atlas.region.id]=atlas.snapshot();atlas?.destroy();atlas=null;document.querySelectorAll('.top-nav button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.nav===view));({home,stay,plan,cost,todo}[view]||home)();document.documentElement.dataset.view=view;document.querySelectorAll('.top-nav button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-current',b.dataset.nav===view?'page':'false'));E.notifyParent('B',view)}
function scrollHome(){requestAnimationFrame(()=>{document.querySelector('.journey-hero')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches?'instant':'smooth'})})}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
const column=e.target.closest('[data-column-focus]');if(column&&!e.target.closest('button,a,input,select,label,textarea')){focusHotel(column.dataset.columnFocus);return}
const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;
if(b.dataset.homeDay!==undefined){const v=Number(b.dataset.homeDay);if(v>=-1&&v<8){homeDay=v;homePhoto=0;photoFocus=false;view='home';render();scrollHome()}return}
if(b.dataset.homePhoto!==undefined){const v=Number(b.dataset.homePhoto);if(homeDay>=0&&HD.photos[homeDay][v]){homePhoto=v;photoFocus=true;render();scrollHome()}return}
if(b.dataset.openDay!==undefined){day=+b.dataset.openDay;view='plan';render();window.scrollTo(0,0);return}
if(b.dataset.todoToggle!==undefined){const i=+b.dataset.todoToggle;E.state.todos[i]=!E.state.todos[i];E.save();render();return}
if(b.id==='compare-more'){more=!more;const y=window.scrollY;document.getElementById('matrix-slot').innerHTML=matrixHTML();b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(more));b.querySelector('span').textContent=more?'收起次要資料':'展開完整比較';b.querySelector('b').textContent=more?'−':'＋';updateColumnFocus();window.scrollTo(0,y);return}
if(b.dataset.nav){if(['home','stay','plan','cost','todo'].includes(b.dataset.nav)){view=b.dataset.nav;render();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'})}return}
if(b.dataset.region){region=b.dataset.region;render();return}
if(b.dataset.focus){focusHotel(b.dataset.focus);return}
if(b.dataset.pick){E.pick(b.dataset.pick);E.closeModal();render();E.toast('住宿路線與每人費用已更新；外部訂單不受影響');return}
if(b.dataset.detail){details(b.dataset.detail);return}
if(b.dataset.day!==undefined){const n=+b.dataset.day;if(Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=0&&n<8){day=n;render();document.querySelector('.date-rail')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'instant'})}return}
if(b.id==='source-info')sourceInfo();

function serviceReason14(key,x){
 if(key==='arrival')return x.dep<R14.ready?`早於可搭乘時間 ${clock14(R14.ready)}`:'';
 if(key==='ferryOut')return TABLE14.ferryMid.some(y=>y.dep>=x.arr+ +TT14.megiStay+10&&TABLE14.ferryBack.some(z=>z.dep>=y.arr+ +TT14.ogiStay+10))?'':'按目前停留設定，無法接續雙島回程';
 if(key==='ferryMid'){if(!R14.ferryOut||x.dep<R14.ferryOut.arr+ +TT14.megiStay+10)return '抵達女木後的停留／候船時間不足';return TABLE14.ferryBack.some(z=>z.dep>=x.arr+ +TT14.ogiStay+10)?'':'抵達男木後無可行回程';}
 if(key==='ferryBack')return !R14.ferryMid||x.dep<R14.ferryMid.arr+ +TT14.ogiStay+10?'早於男木停留及候船完成時間':'';
 if(key==='returnRail')return TABLE14.returnBus.some(b=>b.dep>=x.arr+ +TT14.transfer&&b.arr<=R14.deadline)?'':'無法轉上符合航班緩衝的機場巴士';
 if(key==='returnBus'){if(!R14.returnRail||x.dep<R14.returnRail.arr+ +TT14.transfer)return '早於特急抵達及轉乘緩衝完成';return x.arr>R14.deadline?`晚於機場目標 ${clock14(R14.deadline)}`:'';}
 if(key==='feeder')return x.dep<780?'祖谷接駁返抵後緩衝不足':'';
 if(key==='west')return !R14.feeder||x.dep<R14.feeder.arr+15?'無法銜接琴平來車及 15 分鐘轉乘緩衝':'';
 if(key==='shimoOut')return TABLE14.shimoBack.some(b=>b.dep>=x.arr+ +TT14.shimoStay+5)?'':'無可銜接回程';
 if(key==='shimoBack')return !R14.shimoOut||x.dep<R14.shimoOut.arr+ +TT14.shimoStay+5?'下灘停留及候車時間不足':'';
 return '';
}

function spline14(ps){if(ps.length<2)return '';let d=`M${ps[0]}`;for(let j=1;j<ps.length;j++){const a=ps[j-1],b=ps[j],prev=ps[j-2]||a,next=ps[j+1]||b,c1=[a[0]+(b[0]-prev[0])/6,a[1]+(b[1]-prev[1])/6],c2=[b[0]-(next[0]-a[0])/6,b[1]-(next[1]-a[1])/6];d+=` C${c1} ${c2} ${b}`;}return d;}

 }

 target(){if(this.island)return this.fit([215,68,390,607]);if(this.day<0)return this.fit([135,100,980,650]);let points=this.nodes.map(n=>n.coord);points.push(...zonePts17(this.day));let xs=points.map(p=>p[0]),ys=points.map(p=>p[1]),a=Math.min(...xs),b=Math.max(...xs),c=Math.min(...ys),d=Math.max(...ys);const ww=Math.max(b-a,4),hh=Math.max(d-c,4),W=ww*1.55,H=hh*1.55;return this.fit([(a+b)/2-W/2,(c+d)/2-H/2,W,H]);}

 clampBox(b){const [bx,by,bw,bh]=this.base;let [x,y,w,h]=b;if(w>=bw)return[...this.base];x=Math.max(bx,Math.min(bx+bw-w,x));y=Math.max(by,Math.min(by+bh-h,y));return[x,y,w,h]}

 this.svg.querySelectorAll('.source-route').forEach(p=>{if(!p.getAttribute('d'))return;const len=p.getTotalLength();let last=p.getPointAtLength(0);const count=Math.min(80,Math.max(10,Math.ceil(len/20)));for(let j=1;j<=count;j++){const next=p.getPointAtLength(len*j/count);segments.push([px([last.x,last.y]),px([next.x,next.y])]);last=next;}});
 let leaders='';this.nodes.forEach((n,j)=>{const [x,y]=px(n.coord),dot=this.svg.querySelector(`[data-nd14="${j}"]`),label=this.el.querySelector(`[data-label14="${j}"]`);dot.setAttribute('r',String((n.kind==='stay'?4:4.2)/sc));dot.setAttribute('stroke-width',String(2/sc));label.style.display='block';if(x<0||y<0||x>this.w||y>this.h){label.style.display='none';return;}const w=label.offsetWidth,h=label.offsetHeight;const pos=RouteLabels.place(x,y,w,h,this.w,this.h,occupied,segments,[[-w-13,-h/2],[14,-h/2],[-w/2,17]]);if(!pos){label.style.display='none';return;}occupied.push(pos);label.style.left=pos.x+'px';label.style.top=pos.y+'px';const [ex,ey]=RouteLabels.edge(pos,x,y);if(Math.hypot(ex-x,ey-y)>20)leaders+=`<path d="M${x},${y}L${ex},${ey}"/>`;});const l=this.el.querySelector('.source-leaders');l.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${this.w} ${this.h}`);l.innerHTML=leaders;
 }
 destroy(){this.dead=true;this.ro?.disconnect();this.el.removeEventListener('click',this.click);this.el.removeEventListener('keydown',this.key);this.svg.removeEventListener('pointerdown',this.down);this.svg.removeEventListener('pointermove',this.move);this.svg.removeEventListener('pointerup',this.up);this.svg.removeEventListener('pointercancel',this.up)}
}
